title: UnrealIRCd: security flaw used in attacks
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 6 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

summary: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Nov 16, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
